newsitem.title: UK: IPE natgas price direction mixed as volume recover.
newsitem.headline: IPE natgas price direction mixed as volume recover.

text.p: IPE natural gas futures kicked into life on Tuesday afternoon as the first deals of the week finally got done after three blank sessions.

A total of 190 lots was traded in eight separate trades. Only July, August, November and May were untraded. The flurry of deals included the first trade for June 1998, which has been available for trading since the end of May. A single 25-lot trade was done in June at 10.70 pence a therm just a few seconds before the close of the session.

The price direction was mixed, with five of the traded months registering falls while three saw prices rising. Next June saw the biggest fall, of 0.245 pence a therm, while April 1998 rose most, by 0.13 pence from Monday's settlement level to 11.40 pence a therm.

But front-month July was untraded, with a closing bid at 9.65 pence a therm against an offer of 9.95 pence. August was also untraded, although bid and offered in a much tighter range of 9.90/9.95 pence a therm.
Volumes have been erratic on the contract recently as 250 lots were done on Friday, then none on Monday. No deals were done on Tuesday morning, before the afternoon session suddenly took off.
